quotes.speaker: Brayden Burries
quotes.summary_phrase: Brayden Burries on his first NBA start and preparation
quotes.excerpt: It's a great opportunity to come out here and just try my best, get my best effort

text_blocks.speaker: Unidentified speaker
text_blocks.text: Brayden, making your first NBA start tonight, what does the moment mean to you?

text_blocks.speaker: Brayden Burries
text_blocks.text: It's a great opportunity to come out here and just try my best, get my best effort, and be the best version of myself. Have fun.

quotes.social_post: Brayden Burries says he is treating his first NBA start as a great opportunity to give his best effort and have fun.

structured.context: Brayden Burries discusses his mindset and preparation ahead of his first NBA start.

quotes.speaker: Brayden Burries
quotes.summary_phrase: Brayden Burries on focus and making the most of opportunities
quotes.excerpt: You don't know how many opportunities you're going to get, so just try to make the best

text_blocks.speaker: Unidentified speaker
text_blocks.text: How has that changed your preparations for tonight?

text_blocks.speaker: Brayden Burries
text_blocks.text: Nothing changes. Now it's got to be a little bit more focused. You don't know how many opportunities you're going to get, so just try to make the best of my opportunity and be the best version of myself.

quotes.social_post: Brayden Burries on his preparation for his first start: Nothing changes, but it has to be a little bit more focused.

structured.context: Brayden Burries explains how his preparation remains consistent despite the increased focus required for his first start.

quotes.speaker: Brayden Burries
quotes.summary_phrase: Brayden Burries on his growth and learning through NBA experience
quotes.excerpt: The more experience I'm getting, the better I'm becoming.

text_blocks.speaker: Unidentified speaker
text_blocks.text: How do you feel like you've grown through a couple of games now?

text_blocks.speaker: Brayden Burries
text_blocks.text: I feel like I'm getting better game by game, little by little. That comes with experience, and the more experience I'm getting, the better I'm becoming.

quotes.social_post: Brayden Burries says he feels like he is getting better game by game as he gains more NBA experience.

structured.context: Brayden Burries reflects on his personal growth and development through his initial NBA game experiences.

quotes.speaker: Brayden Burries
quotes.summary_phrase: Brayden Burries on the biggest adjustment to NBA basketball
quotes.excerpt: You got great players and they make fewer mistakes, so just trying to figure out how

text_blocks.speaker: Brayden Burries
text_blocks.text: Fouling, I guess. It's just basketball. You got great players and they make fewer mistakes, so just trying to figure out how I can make fewer mistakes while I'm out there.

quotes.social_post: Brayden Burries identifies fouling as the biggest adjustment he has had to make to the NBA game so far.

structured.context: Brayden Burries identifies fouling and minimizing mistakes as the biggest adjustments to the NBA level.

quotes.speaker: Brayden Burries
quotes.summary_phrase: Brayden Burries on his mindset as an NBA starter
quotes.excerpt: How can I impact the game of winning? Every time I'm on the floor

text_blocks.speaker: Unidentified speaker
text_blocks.text: Tonight when you run on the floor as a starter, what are you going to be thinking about?

text_blocks.speaker: Brayden Burries
text_blocks.text: How can I impact the game of winning? Every time I'm on the floor, and how can I be a great teammate and be coachable. We got to get the win tonight.

quotes.social_post: Brayden Burries says his mindset as a starter is focused on how he can impact winning and be a great teammate.

structured.context: Brayden Burries describes his mindset regarding impacting the game and being a good teammate as he prepares to start.
